poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Hold the bar at your thighs with your palms up.

poses.label: Drag up
poses.description: Let your elbows move behind you as you draw the bar close to your body.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Keep the bar close and stop before your shoulders roll forward.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower along the same path and return your elbows to your sides.

limitations: Check the bar path and visibility in the in-app side view before indexing.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
